#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Drive the Alpine VM serial console to: log in, install openssh, set root
password, and start sshd. Prints serial transcript to stdout."""
import sys, time
import pexpect

SOCK = "/tmp/vm-serial.sock"
PASS = "password123"
LOG = "/tmp/serial_setup.log"

class Logger:
    def __init__(self, path):
        self.f = open(path, "wb")
    def write(self, data):
        if isinstance(data, bytes):
            self.f.write(data)
        else:
            self.f.write(data.encode("utf-8", "replace"))
        self.f.flush()
    def flush(self):
        self.f.flush()

child = pexpect.spawn("socat - UNIX-CONNECT:%s" % SOCK, encoding="utf-8", timeout=180)
child.logfile_read = sys.stdout
child.logfile = Logger(LOG)

def send(cmd):
    child.send(cmd + "\r")

def expect_any(patterns, timeout=180):
    """Expect one of several patterns; return the index matched."""
    return child.expect(patterns, timeout=timeout)

# 1. Wait for a login prompt or shell. The Alpine live ISO auto-boots to a
#    getty login prompt on ttyS0.
print("\n=== waiting for login prompt ===", flush=True)
idx = expect_any([r"login:", r"# ", r"localhost:~#"], timeout=240)
time.sleep(1)

if idx == 0:
    send("root")
    # root has no password on the live ISO -> goes straight to shell
    idx2 = expect_any([r"# ", r"Password:", r"localhost:~#"], timeout=60)
    if idx2 == 1:
        send("")  # empty password
        expect_any([r"# ", r"localhost:~#"], timeout=60)
else:
    # already at a shell (autologin)
    pass

# Stabilize: send a newline and wait for prompt
time.sleep(1)
send("")
expect_any([r"#"], timeout=30)
time.sleep(0.5)

# 2. Bring up networking via DHCP on eth0 (user-mode net)
print("\n=== configuring network ===", flush=True)
send("ip link set eth0 up")
expect_any([r"#"], timeout=30)
send("udhcpc -i eth0 -t 5 -n 2>&1 | tail -3")
expect_any([r"#"], timeout=60)
send("ip addr show eth0 | grep inet")
expect_any([r"#"], timeout=30)

# 3. Set up the apk repositories from the CD-ROM so we can install openssh
#    offline. The live system already has /media/cdrom mounted.
print("\n=== configuring apk + installing openssh ===", flush=True)
send("ls /media/cdrom/apks >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo CDROM_OK || echo NO_CDROM")
expect_any([r"#"], timeout=30)
send("mkdir -p /media/cdrom && mount -o ro /dev/sr0 /media/cdrom 2>/dev/null; mount | grep cdrom || echo already_mounted")
expect_any([r"#"], timeout=30)

# Point apk at the local repo on the cdrom (offline install)
send("setup-apkrepos -c1 2>/dev/null; echo 'exit:' $?")
expect_any([r"#"], timeout=40)
# Force the repository file to the local CDROM apk tree
send("printf 'file:///media/cdrom/apks\\n' > /etc/apk/repositories")
expect_any([r"#"], timeout=30)
send("cat /etc/apk/repositories")
expect_any([r"#"], timeout=30)
send("apk update 2>&1 | tail -3; echo APK_UPDATE_DONE_$?")
expect_any([r"APK_UPDATE_DONE_", r"#"], timeout=120)

send("apk add openssh openssh-server 2>&1 | tail -6; echo OPENSSH_INSTALL_DONE_$?")
expect_any([r"OPENSSH_INSTALL_DONE_", r"#"], timeout=180)

# 4. Set root password
print("\n=== setting root password ===", flush=True)
send("echo 'root:%s' | chpasswd; echo CHPASSWD_DONE_$?" % PASS)
expect_any([r"CHPASSWD_DONE_", r"#"], timeout=60)

# 5. Generate host keys + start sshd
print("\n=== starting sshd ===", flush=True)
send("ssh-keygen -A 2>&1 | tail -3")
expect_any([r"#"], timeout=60)
# Permit root login with password (default sshd_config may restrict root)
send("sed -i 's/^#\\?PermitRootLogin.*/PermitRootLogin yes/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config")
expect_any([r"#"], timeout=30)
send("sed -i 's/^#\\?PasswordAuthentication.*/PasswordAuthentication yes/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config")
expect_any([r"#"], timeout=30)
send("grep -E 'PermitRootLogin|PasswordAuthentication' /etc/ssh/sshd_config | tail -4")
expect_any([r"#"], timeout=30)

# Start sshd directly (openrc may not be running on a live ISO)
send("/usr/sbin/sshd; echo SSHD_START_DONE_$?")
expect_any([r"SSHD_START_DONE_", r"#"], timeout=60)
send("pgrep -a sshd || echo NO_SSHD_PROC")
expect_any([r"#"], timeout=30)
send("ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null | grep :22 || netstat -tlnp 2>/dev/null | grep :22 || echo NO_LISTENER")
expect_any([r"#"], timeout=30)

print("\n=== setup script complete ===", flush=True)
child.close(force=True)
